sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the opening header and date for Lag BaOmer 5745.

translations.translation: With the help of Heaven.
Lag BaOmer 5745*

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as praises of the Creator arouse His will to bestow, so too praises of Rashbi were necessary to arouse his incomparable influence.

translations.translation: To understand the concept of Rashbi,
it is known the discourse of Lag BaOmer of the Rebbe Maharash1
(the one who taught "lechat’chilah ariber"2),
that what we find in the Zohar3
that they praised Rashbi with awesome praises4,
such as Rabbi Yehudah would call him "Shabbat"5,
and "Who is Panai"6
"The Lord God, that is Rashbi"7,
this is understood from the concept of the praises with which they praise the Creator, may He be blessed,
for at first glance it is perplexing,
does He, may He be blessed, need our praises8?
And the explanation of this is known9,
that because all the worlds are incomparable to Him, may He be blessed,
and the flow of influence to the worlds is a descent relative to Him, may He be blessed,
therefore, in order to arouse in Him, may He be blessed, the will to bestow upon the worlds, it is through praises.
And this is what our sages, of blessed memory, said10
"A person should always arrange the praise of the Omnipresent and then pray,"
for although prayer is a positive commandment from the Torah to request one's needs from the Holy One, blessed be He11,
and the commandment of the Torah is a granting of power,
nevertheless,
there must first be an arrangement of the praise of the Omnipresent,
through which they arouse in Him, may He be blessed, the will to bestow the needs of the one who praises.
And similarly, this is also regarding Rashbi,
that due to the extreme greatness of Rashbi relative to the other Tannaim,
that he was separate from them in an incomparable manner,
therefore,
in order to arouse his influence,
they needed to praise him.
And it can be said,
that what is said in the discourse, that the concept of the praises of Rashbi is understood from the concept of the praises of the Omnipresent,
is in addition to bringing proof that in order to arouse an influence that is incomparable, praises are needed,
but rather also,
that the incomparability of the other Tannaim relative to Rashbi is analogous to the incomparability of the created being relative to the Creator.
And this is also what is said in the discourse, that they praised him with awesome praises,
for the word "awesome" indicates a matter that is completely separate in value,
to the point that it inspires awe.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Rashbi served as the intermediary between the level of "Eitan" and the Tannaim, who are the foundations of the Oral Torah.

translations.translation: B)
And the concept is,
that it is written12
"And the Eitanim, the foundations of the earth,"
Eitanim is the letters of Tannaim13,
and they are the founders14
of the Oral Torah, which is called by the name "earth"15,
meaning that they draw down the aspect of Eitan into the Oral Torah.
And it can be said that the drawing down of Eitan to the Tannaim is through Rashbi,
for he was the intermediary between the aspect of Eitan and the Tannaim,
as is explained at length in the discourse16.
